channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK weapon manufacturing major aim for Project Grayburn
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that Project GRAYBURN, the British Army's future small arms programme, remains in its concept phase and does not yet have a defined measure of "export potential". The post UK weapon manufacturing major aim for Project Grayburn first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Massive surge of American F-15 jets heads to UK
item.description: A significant movement of United States Air Force F-15E Strike Eagles is underway towards the United Kingdom. The post Massive surge of American F-15 jets heads to UK first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Attack launched against Iran as explosions rock Tehran
item.description: Explosions have been reported in Tehran after Israel confirmed it had launched strikes against Iran, with US officials later saying American forces are also participating in the operation. The post Attack launched against Iran as explosions rock Tehran first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK-Norway firms detail 50 knot Littoral Strike Craft
item.description: BAE Systems Maritime has set out further detail on its joint UK–Norway Littoral Strike Craft (LSC) programme, describing it as a fast, low-signature vessel designed to support modern amphibious operations in contested coastal environments. The post UK-Norway firms detail 50 knot Littoral Strike Craft first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK commits funding to testing Atlantic Bastion concept
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that GBP 14 million in combined government and industry funding has already been committed this year to testing and development work under the Atlantic Bastion programme. The post UK commits funding to testing Atlantic Bastion concept first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to run three exercises at Oman hub in 2026-27
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that three training exercises are planned at the UK Oman-based hub in the 2026-27 financial year, as the facility continues its transition into a broader tri-service site. The post UK to run three exercises at Oman hub in 2026-27 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britih Army training activity in Germany climbs again
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has published a ten-year breakdown of training activity at the Land Regional Hub Germany, outlining how many field training exercises have taken place at the site each year. The post Britih Army training activity in Germany climbs again first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK warns of increasing Russian Arctic militarisation
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has reiterated concerns over Russia's growing military activity in the Arctic and High North, citing increased submarine operations and continued investment in regional bases and air defence systems. The post UK warns of increasing Russian Arctic militarisation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British destroyer integrates with French carrier group
item.description: HMS Dauntless has been operating alongside the French Navy during exercise ORION 26, joining the carrier strike group centred on the aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle. The post British destroyer integrates with French carrier group first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British jets in the air in defensive action over Middle East
item.description: British fast jets are flying as part of regional defensive operations in the Middle East, the Defence Secretary has confirmed, following US and Israeli strikes against Iran. The post British jets in the air in defensive action over Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
